text:
Claire (Finance): FYI BillTrackr sent a renewal + last invoice showing a new 'throughput surcharge'. Renewal is +21%. Can procurement please validate and look at alternatives (Spendwise, QuotaLabs)?

Marta (Billing): I see the invoice. Surcharge code BT-THRU-2025 for $11,200. Our exported usage doesn't show that line. Opening a dispute and requested their pricing matrix.

Diego (Procurement): Hold signing. I'll ask BillTrackr to justify the surcharge and request a migration credit. I'll also send a short RFP to Spendwise and QuotaLabs for a TCO comparison. Need last 9 months usage by sku.

Owen (Platform): Integration note: BillTrackr currently drops hourly Parquet to S3 and we run a nightly reconcile. Spendwise advertises delta webhooks which could save ~10% on compute. QuotaLabs supports bulk replay but charges for backfills. Need sample export schemas.

Sam (Legal): Before sharing usage with alternatives, require NDA + DPA, plus SOC2 Type II and subprocessors list. No data migration until DPAs signed. Also add right-to-audit and breach notification clauses.

Claire (Finance): Marta, can you export month-by-month totals (events/tokens/bytes) for the last 9 months by sku? We'll use that to model per-unit vs flat pricing.

Marta (Billing): Will post sanitized CSV to #finance-data in 2h. Sample rows I'll include:

```
month,sku,events,tokens,bytes
2024-08,billable_events,105400,5123400,234567890
2024-09,billable_events,117800,6012300,276543210
```

Marta (Billing): Also uploaded the invoice to the ticket: invoice_ref_BT_1782501500.pdf.

Diego (Procurement): RFP draft will ask: base fee, per-event/token, burst pricing, egress/storage, onboarding/migration credit, backfill costs, SLA credits (p99), API rate limits, sample export schema, and pilot discount. I'll attach sanitized usage under NDA.

vendor-bot: BillTrackr uploaded renewal_offer_1782501800.pdf. Summary: list $33,000/mo -> proposed $39,900/mo; throughput_surcharge applied at 0.0018/unit.

Claire (Finance): Target negotiation: request 15% off list OR 9mo at current pricing + 3mo free on a 12mo commit. If Spendwise beats TCO by >=10% with limited migration cost, pilot them.

Owen (Platform): Add RFP question: can vendors support webhook delta with event_id, timestamp, sku, qty? If Spendwise matches fields we can POC in ~7 days. Also ask for rate limits for backfills.

Sam (Legal): I'll prep the NDA/DPA template and checklist and share with Procurement. Require BYOK option and 72h breach notification.

Diego (Procurement): Plan: 1) Marta uploads usage (ETA 2h), 2) I send RFP under NDA (ETA 48h), 3) run demos and pilot where helpful. Reconvene after vendor replies. /remind me 4 days to review responses.
